**3. Evaluating the Expectation Value** The position vector _⃗r_ = ( _x, y, z_ ) is an **odd function** under spatial reflection ( _⃗r →−⃗r_ ). 

When evaluating the integral over all space: 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
⟨⃗r⟩ = |ψ 100( ⃗r ) | 2 · r d 3 r = 0<br>� −∞∞ � EVEN �� � ����ODD<br><!-- End of picture text -->

Because the integrand is a product of an even function and an odd function over a symmetric domain, the integral vanishes identically. 



<!-- Start of picture text -->
⟨⃗d⟩ =  −e⟨⃗r⟩ =  0<br><!-- End of picture text -->

Thus, an isolated ground-state hydrogen atom has **zero intrinsic permanent electric dipole moment** .

## **General Theorem on Permanent Electric Dipole Moments:** 

Any non-degenerate energy eigenstate of a system governed by a parityinvariant Hamiltonian has **zero permanent electric dipole moment** ( _⟨⃗d⟩_ = 0).
